replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
Hi DinoMonkey,

By the way, I was the one who punished you and looking at the story you given me, I believe I am at fault here. When the report came in, I teleported to you and I didn't see that you were there previously and had died. The only thing I saw was that you were going straight for the guy on the side of the map and that you dug to where the other player was.

I will try get you appealed as soon as possible. Sorry for any inconveniences.

-PokerFace
